g.text: WEB04 - Recover a Failed Feature Read
settle loading; show results or EmptyState
settle loading; retain safe resource context
show localized read failure with role=alert
list could not be loaded; Retry is available
start a new loading state; disable duplicate retry
show localized read failure; keep Retry available
A failed GET is safe to repeat. Each GET has its own loading lifecycle.
No mutation confirmation or operation-status lookup is required.
